data.gender_notes: Marlie is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Marie, which means ‘bitter sea’ or ‘rebellion’ in Latin, and ‘Mary’ in Greek. Marlie is a feminine name that can be seen as a rebellious or independent spirit, inspired by the biblical figure of Mary, the mother of Jesus. The name Marlie carries the meaning “Rebellion, little Mary” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Marlie usually hope their child will grow to embody rebellion, little mary and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of resilience and determination, inspired by the strength and faith of the biblical Mary.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Marlie total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
